bank.retain_mission: Durable engineering knowledge only: technical decisions and their rationale, confirmed root causes and fixes, proven procedures and workarounds, and non-obvious constraints. Every memory is keyed by its tracker issue ID, stated as a literal token at the start of the content. Ignore routine progress, unconfirmed hypotheses, and anything cheaply recoverable from the repository or the issue tracker.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize across past engineering work to explain why an area is shaped the way it is, surfacing prior decisions, confirmed failures, and constraints that should guide the work at hand.

directives.name: issue-id-keying
directives.content: Every retained memory must lead with its tracker issue ID as a literal token, for example 'ABC-1234:'. The issue ID is the join key for later recall.

directives.name: context-vocabulary
directives.content: Retain with exactly one of these contexts: 'decisions' for a technical choice and its rationale, 'learnings' for a confirmed root cause or a lesson that prevents repeated work, 'procedures' for a proven command, workflow, or workaround, 'constraints' for a non-obvious limitation that will matter again.

directives.name: no-secrets
directives.content: Never retain credentials, API keys, tokens, connection strings, private keys, or customer names and customer data.
